:::{#def-intercept}
#### Intercept, y-intercept

The **intercept** (or **y-intercept**) of a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) $f$ whose [domain](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-domain) contains $0$
is $f(0)$,
the height at which the [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of $f$ crosses the vertical axis.

:::
